description.name: Entry
description.text: Fifteen single hybrid ranged attacks (0.60 or 1.50 each), grants [ATK and MND +30%, DEF and RES +25% (25s)] to all allies, grants [Awoken Wind Agent], [Damage Cap +10000] to the user, and cause [Imperil Prismatic 10% (15s)]/[Imperil Prismatic 30% (15s)] if there are 0-3/4+ Thief or Job/Beyond allies

description.name: ATK and MND +30%, DEF and RES +25% (25s)
description.text: ATK and MND +30%, DEF and RES +25%

description.name: Awoken Wind Agent
description.text: Wind abilities don't consume uses, Wind abilities trigger 1 additional time, cast speed x2.00/2.25/2.50/2.75/3.00 for Wind abilities at ability rank 1/2/3/4/5

description.name: Imperil Prismatic 10% (15s)
description.text: Causes [Imperil Fire 10% (15s)], [Imperil Ice 10% (15s)], [Imperil Lightning 10% (15s)], [Imperil Earth 10% (15s)], [Imperil Wind 10% (15s)], [Imperil Water 10% (15s)], [Imperil Holy 10% (15s)], [Imperil Dark 10% (15s)] and [Imperil Poison 10% (15s)]

description.name: Imperil Prismatic 30% (15s)
description.text: Causes [Imperil Fire 30% (15s)], [Imperil Ice 30% (15s)], [Imperil Lightning 30% (15s)], [Imperil Earth 30% (15s)], [Imperil Wind 30% (15s)], [Imperil Water 30% (15s)], [Imperil Holy 30% (15s)], [Imperil Dark 30% (15s)] and [Imperil Poison 30% (15s)]
